limitations: Inventory describes files present at generation time; it does not represent current live Fmarket coverage.

Source terms, published-time semantics, and live schema require independent verification.

prioritized_next_steps.action: Populate only datasets needed for research; preserve missingness and report per-source coverage rather than filling gaps.
Accumulate verified full holdings, fund AUM/flows, official publication times, NAV history, and benchmark/fee data before any ranking or backtest.
Do not interpret inferred holdings changes as trades or assert investment alpha; validate only after a point-in-time dataset is sufficiently covered.
